dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "We're going to Natlan! Mom told me that there could be herbs there that aren't in any medicine books."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I've heard that the hot springs in Natlan help with muscle relaxation and blood circulation. Perhaps they will be beneficial for Jialiang..."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Let's not think too much about that for now, and just focus on the journey! We are going to enjoy every moment we can spend as a family."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: (At the end of the message, you see three crudely drawn stick figures. It shows a man, a woman and their son, holding hands as they set off on a new journey.)
